appraisal_events.evidence: « Tous ces gens-là, vous n'avez pas assez de méfiance, c'est des copiateurs. » ... Bloch se donnait, en effet, un alibi rétrospectif ... (Il n'aurait pas pu me le lire encore, mais allait l'écrire le soir même.)
appraisal_events.explanation: Françoise warns the narrator that Bloch is an untrustworthy copier of his ideas; the narrator's own ironic parenthetical confirms Bloch's claim to have already written something similar was false, since he would only write it that same evening, lending credence to her accusation.

status_effects.explanation: Bloch's credibility is locally undermined: both Françoise's warning and the narrator's confirming irony present him as an opportunistic imitator of the narrator's ideas.

ambiguities: The passage's meditation on Mlle de Saint-Loup's inherited features (noting her nose follows Saint-Loup's line rather than Swann's, and that 'the soul of this Guermantes had vanished') touches Saint-Loup and Swann only as objects of genealogical/mortality reflection, not staged social appraisal; they were left unscored as this reads as essayistic meditation on time and heredity rather than a local evaluative event.
